root_cause: Workflow_dispatch accepted a missing/blank functions input, then derived function scope from the latest GitHub main commit. Portal-only main commits produce an empty Edge scope, making source-parity steps not applicable and potentially letting CI appear green without testing the invalid SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN.
prevention_rule: Manual Supabase Edge Production Authority runs must supply nonempty comma-separated registered function slugs; reject blank input with SUPABASE_EDGE_MANUAL_SCOPE_REQUIRED. Keep automatic push diff scoping, protected-main ancestry, Management API credential authentication and byte-for-byte provider parity intact.
